Chief_Complaint.content: Patient presents with decreased hearing compared to usual.
Chief_Complaint.source_text: Yeah, so I just feel I can't really hear as well as I used to, like my hearing is kind of deteriorating in some way.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Duration of hearing difficulty is about six weeks.
Hearing difficulty affects the left ear only.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Uh just the left ear, yeah.

Doctor: Alright, so your right ear is fine.
Patient: It seems be yeah.
Uh it's kind of on and off.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient reports intermittent ringing in the left ear (tinnitus).
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Um, I occasionally get like a ringing in my left ear, uh just on the one side

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Ringing in the ear is triggered by watching TV or listening to music.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: some things trigger it as well. So, for example, if I'm watching TV or listen to music or something that'll solve the ringing in the ear.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient has experienced episodes of dizziness.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: there's actually been a few times when I felt kind of a bit sick or a bit dizzy as well.
Uh nothing major it's just kind of uh it's, it's

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Dizziness described as off-balance rather than true vertigo.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: not, not proper room spinning or anything like that but just, just a little bit kind of off balance.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Previous similar episode occurred about one year ago and lasted only a couple of days.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Um I had something maybe, about a year ago, but it only lasted a couple of days, it wasn't anything as long as this.

Doctor: Um, and, um, have you had any pain from the ear at all?
Patient: Uh no my left ear.

Doctor: Um, have, have you been experiencing any fever?
Patient: Uh, not specifically apart from the dizziness so much.

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Patient denies chest pain associated with the symptoms.
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text:
Doctor: Have, have you had any chest pain with it?
Patient: No.

Assessment.content: Ringing in the ear is identified as tinnitus.
Assessment.source_text: The ringing that you got, that you've got, it's something called Tinnitus. OK?

Assessment.content: Impacted earwax causing conductive symptoms is a possible cause that needs to be excluded.
Assessment.source_text:
'K. I'm just exclude the simple things. Simple things might be wax. You know. Someone might have impacted wax, blocking the tube going into the eardrum, which can
lead to muffled hearing.

Assessment.content: Differential includes a problem inside the eardrum or the inner ear balance system.
Assessment.source_text: It might be that there's a problem inside the drum or the balance system within the ear.

Assessment.content: Current situation is not considered an emergency.

Plan_of_Care.content: Arrange a face-to-face clinic appointment within 4–5 days for otoscopic examination to assess for blockage versus other causes.
Plan_of_Care.source_text:
So, um, what I think we could do is, um, maybe if we book you in for a face-to-face appointment in one of our clinics. It's not an emergency.
It can be done within the next four, five days or so, OK? ... one of the GPs will just have a quick look in the ear and figure out
whether there's physical blockage or whether there's something else going on

Plan_of_Care.content: Doctor will message the admin team to schedule the clinic visit.
Plan_of_Care.source_text:
And then, um, what I'll do, I'll send a message to our admin team.
I'll ask them to slot you into the clinic, one of our clinics in that time frame.

Plan_of_Care.content: Provide a tinnitus information leaflet link for the patient to read before the appointment.
Plan_of_Care.source_text:
I'm going to, uh, put
paste the link for a leaflet about Tinnitus, um, in the notes for this appointment. I'd really appreciate it if you could start reading about it.

Plan_of_Care.content: Safety-netting: if any issues arise before the clinic visit, book another video appointment.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: If there's any problem, any issues between now and when the clinic appointment is, just book another appointment and you can speak to one of us over video, OK?

Follow_up_Information.content: Follow-up planned in about 4–5 days with another GP.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: what we'll do is we'll see you in about four, five days time. It won't be with me, it'll be another GP

Follow_up_Information.content: Patient to ring the support team using the number in the notes to arrange the appointment.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: bear with me five minutes and then you can ring the support team, I'll leave the number in the notes for this appointment. Ring them, and then they'll slot you in, OK?
